from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p=Path('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx')
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    ns={'x':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
    ss=[]
    root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('x:si',ns):
        ss.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t'%ns['x'])))
    sh=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    rows=[]
    for row in sh.findall('.//x:row',ns):
        vals=[]
        for c in row.findall('x:c',ns):
            v=c.find('x:v',ns)
            value='' if v is None else v.text
            if c.get('t')=='s' and value"'!='"'': value=ss[int(value)]
            vals.append((c.get('r'),value))
        rows.append(vals)
    for row in rows: print(row)
print('featureCounts columns:',len(Path('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0].split()))
print('featureCounts data rows:',sum(1 for _ in Path('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt').open())-1)
print('gencode lines:',sum(1 for _ in Path('inputs/gencode.v31.primary_assembly.genes.csv').open()))
print('HGNC lines:',sum(1 for _ in Path('inputs/HGNC_05-09-19.txt').open()))
